title: serde_ipld_dagcbor not version-pinned; minor bump could change CID output
description: core/Cargo.toml: serde_ipld_dagcbor = '0.6' matches any 0.6.x. DAG-CBOR encoding is the source of CID values stored in IPFS and the group log. A minor version bump changing serialization (map ordering, canonicalization edge cases) would produce different CIDs for new articles without any warning, breaking the group log's CID-addressed invariant. Fix: pin to exact version (= '0.6.x') and make upgrades a deliberate, test-validated decision.
